messages.content:
# Service Delivery Coordinator

## PROFESSIONAL EXECUTION CONTEXT
USER_REQUEST: Create a standard reusable NDIS care plan template for provider staff, participants and representatives. Follow the authored care_plan blueprint specification exactly.
OPERATION: CREATE
DELIVERABLE_TYPE: STANDARD_REUSABLE_NDIS_CARE_PLAN_TEMPLATE
PROFESSIONAL_DOMAIN: care_plan
SPECIFICITY: STANDARD_NON_PARTICIPANT_SPECIFIC
AUDIENCE: NDIS provider staff, participant and participant representative
CONTEXT_SUFFICIENCY: MINIMAL_ORGANISATIONAL_CONTEXT
PRIMARY_SPECIALIST: service_delivery_coordinator
SUPPORTING_SPECIALISTS: operations_manager, behaviour_support_implementation_specialist, authorised_program_officer, incident_safeguarding_specialist, compliance_quality_manager, knowledge_documentation_specialist
PROFESSIONAL_METHOD_ROLE: internal_method_only

AUTHORITY_HIERARCHY:
1. Safety, WorkerProfile boundaries and external professional authority limits
2. Current binding external requirements and authoritative regulator guidance
3. User requested operation and deliverable
4. Blueprint professional methodology as internal process authority
5. Organisation templates for house structure, terminology, style and approved organisation-specific provisions
6. Organisation context, memory and KRS evidence
7. Approved examples as style and quality references only

REQUIRED_PROFESSIONAL_CONTENT:
- Support Plan Meeting
- Goals
- About Me
- History and Background
- Undertaking ADL
- Communication and Communication Strategy
- Mobility and Mobility Strategy
- Support Delivery and Client Safety
- Behavioural Management
- Restrictive Practices
- Mealtime Management Strategy
- Disaster Management Strategy
- Client Endorsement
- Document Control

ALLOWED_FACTUAL_PLACEHOLDERS:
[PARTICIPANT_NAME], [DATE_OF_BIRTH], [GENDER], [LANGUAGE_SPOKEN], [NDIS_NUMBER], [DIAGNOSIS], [PEOPLE_PRESENT], [SUPPORT_PLAN_DEVELOPED_BY], [PLAN_DATE], [GOALS], [CURRENT_SITUATION], [ACTIONS], [PERSON_RESPONSIBLE], [TIMEFRAME], [OUTCOMES], [STRENGTHS], [LIKES], [DISLIKES], [WHAT_MATTERS], [COMMUNICATION_PREFERENCES], [INFORMAL_SUPPORTS], [HISTORY_BACKGROUND], [SUPPORT_NEEDS], [PREFERENCES], [COMMUNICATION_NEEDS], [MOBILITY_AID], [SUPPORT_TYPE], [SUPPORT_DESCRIPTION], [BEHAVIOUR], [POSSIBLE_TRIGGER], [REDIRECTION_STRATEGY], [RESTRICTIVE_PRACTICE], [AUTHORISATION_STATUS], [MEALTIME_STRATEGY], [DISASTER_ARRANGEMENTS], [PROVIDED_TO], [CONSENT_OBTAINED], [REVIEW_DATE], [SIGNATURE], [SIGN_OFF], [FORM_ID], [VERSION], [DATE], [DATE_FOR_REVIEW], [GOAL], [WHAT_MATTERS_TO_ME], [HOW_I_PREFER_TO_COMMUNICATE], [PEOPLE_WHO_MATTER_TO_ME], [RELEVANT_HISTORY], [PRIOR_SERVICE_INVOLVEMENT], [RISK_RELEVANT_CONTEXT], [SOURCE_DOCUMENTS_AND_DATES], [SOURCE_DOCUMENTS], [VERBAL_NON_VERBAL], [EXPRESSIVE_CAPACITY], [RECEPTIVE_CAPACITY], [COMMUNICATION_AID_OR_SYSTEM_USED], [COMMUNICATION_STRATEGY], [MOBILITY_AID_REQUIRED], [AID_OR_EQUIPMENT_USED], [TRANSFER_METHOD], [NUMBER_OF_WORKERS_REQUIRED], [NUMBER], [MOBILITY_OVERVIEW], [MOBILITY_STRATEGY], [SUPPORT_TYPES], [IN_HOME_ADL], [PERSONAL_CARE], [COMMUNITY_ACCESS], [TRANSPORT_AND_TRAVEL_TRAINING], [TRANSPORT], [SOCIAL_GROUP_ACTIVITY], [BEHAVIOURAL_REDIRECTION], [COMPANIONSHIP_AND_MENTORSHIP], [COMPANIONSHIP], [THERAPEUTIC_CLEANING], [DESCRIPTION_PER_SELECTED_TYPE], [DESCRIPTION], [ON_CALL_CONTACT], [SERVICE_MANAGER_CONTACT], [PRACTICE_TYPE], [WHAT_IT_IS_IN_PLAIN_LANGUAGE], [WHAT_THE_WORKER_DOES], [WHAT_THE_WORKER_MUST_NOT_DO], [AUTHORISATION_STATUS_AND_REFERENCE], [RECORDING_REQUIREMENT], [SOURCE_RISK_ASSESSMENT_AND_DATE], [SOURCE_RISK_ASSESSMENT], [FOOD_TEXTURE], [FLUID_CONSISTENCY], [POSITIONING], [SUPERVISION_LEVEL], [EQUIPMENT], [WORKER_ACTIONS], [EVACUATION_ASSISTANCE_REQUIRED], [ASSEMBLY_POINT], [EQUIPMENT_NEEDED], [COMMUNICATION_APPROACH_DURING_EVACUATION], [MEDICATIONS_OR_EQUIPMENT_TO_TAKE], [WHO_TO_NOTIFY], [GENERAL_RISK_ARRANGEMENTS], [LOCATION_SPECIFIC_RISK_ARRANGEMENTS], [TRANSPORT_CONTINGENCY], [WHAT_THE_WORKER_CARRIES], [HOW_THE_PARTICIPANT_IS_RETURNED_TO_A_SAFE_LOCATION], [PARTICIPANT_OR_REPRESENTATIVE_NAME], [RELATIONSHIP], [PLAN_PROVIDED_TO], [NEXT_REVIEW_DATE]

OUTPUT_CONTRACT:
Produce an actual reusable NDIS Care Plan template containing drafted professional support-planning content. Internal professional work is not the artifact payload.
OUTPUT_DEPTH: comprehensive; minimum sections: 14; configured output budget: 6000.
Draft substantive clauses/fields for every mandatory requirement; do not compress a full professional document into a short outline.

QUALITY_CONTRACT:
- No unresolved professional-content placeholders.
- No leaked internal methodology headings in CREATE, TAILOR, UPDATE or COMPLETE deliverables.
- No empty substantive sections or instruction-only clauses.
- No mandatory user-facing section is placeholder-only or dominated by labels and factual variables.
- Mandatory professional deliverable requirement coverage is 100% before Completed Work/artifacts are finalised.
- Completed Work/artifacts consume only the final deliverable payload.

Return only valid JSON matching the strict schema. The server assembles markdown from deliverable.sections[]. Do not include internal requirement IDs in user-facing headings or body content.

=== REPAIR ONLY THESE REQUIREMENTS ===

[
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-support-plan-meeting",
    "requirement": "Support Plan Meeting section contains client name, date of birth, gender, language spoken, NDIS number, diagnosis, people present, support plan developed by, and date for review.",
    "targetLocation": "Support Plan Meeting (header)",
    "adequacyCriteria": [
      "Every field present and labelled",
      "People present names people who attended the planning meeting. A document title in that field is a defect",
      "Where the plan was developed using allied health reports or a BSP rather than a meeting, the source documents are named with their dates",
      "Date for Review is a real date, later than the plan date",
      "Diagnosis is transcribed from a clinical source, never inferred"
    ],
    "reason": "Template section does not satisfy derived template criteria: missing authored completionPrompt."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-goals",
    "requirement": "Goals section contains a table per objective with current situation, goal, actions, person responsible, timeframe, and outcomes.",
    "targetLocation": "Goals",
    "adequacyCriteria": [
      "Minimum three personal goals present",
      "NDIS goals present where an NDIS plan exists, sourced from the plan or allied health reports",
      "Current situation is specific to this participant, not generic",
      "Goal states what the participant will do or achieve",
      "Actions state what will be done to support the goal",
      "Person responsible names a role or person. \"The team\" is a defect",
      "Timeframe is a date or bounded period. \"Ongoing\" is not a timeframe and fails",
      "Outcomes describes what achievement looks like. This may be generated, but must follow from the stated goal and actions — never invented independently of them"
    ],
    "reason": "Template section does not satisfy derived template criteria: missing declared template fields/structure: Minimum three personal goal rows, plus one row per NDIS plan goal; missing authored completionPrompt."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-about-me",
    "requirement": "About Me section contains the person — strengths, likes, dislikes, what matters to them, communication preferences, and informal supports.",
    "targetLocation": "About Me",
    "adequacyCriteria": [
      "Strengths stated",
      "Likes and dislikes stated",
      "Informal supports identified",
      "Forensic history, family psychiatric history, trauma and service-involvement history do NOT belong here. They go to History and Background (4.4)",
      "Written about the person, not about their deficits"
    ],
    "reason": "Template section does not satisfy derived template criteria: missing authored completionPrompt."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-history-background",
    "requirement": "History and Background section contains background a support worker operationally needs — relevant history, prior service involvement, and risk-relevant context.",
    "targetLocation": "History and Background",
    "adequacyCriteria": [
      "Carries only what a support worker operationally needs. Not the full file",
      "Every historical claim traceable to a named source document",
      "No clinical interpretation added beyond what the source states",
      "[OPEN] Should this section state an access restriction, given its content?"
    ],
    "reason": "Template section does not satisfy derived template criteria: missing authored completionPrompt."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-undertaking-adl",
    "requirement": "Undertaking ADL section contains personal grooming capacity and self-hygiene routine.",
    "targetLocation": "Undertaking ADL",
    "adequacyCriteria": [
      "States what the participant does independently",
      "States what needs prompting",
      "States what needs hands-on support",
      "A capacity statement with no support description is inadequate"
    ],
    "reason": "Template section does not satisfy derived template criteria: missing authored completionPrompt."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-communication-strategy",
    "requirement": "Communication and Communication Strategy section contains verbal / non-verbal; expressive and receptive capacity; overview and effective strategy.",
    "targetLocation": "Communication and Communication Strategy",
    "adequacyCriteria": [
      "Capacity indicators completed",
      "Strategy narrative present. A ticked capacity box with an empty overview is a defect",
      "Strategy states what a worker should actually do",
      "Capacity indicators must not contradict narrative content elsewhere in the plan (mechanically checkable)"
    ],
    "reason": "Template section does not satisfy derived template criteria: missing authored completionPrompt."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-mobility-strategy",
    "requirement": "Mobility and Mobility Strategy section contains aid required / not required; overview and strategy.",
    "targetLocation": "Mobility and Mobility Strategy",
    "adequacyCriteria": [
      "Capacity indicator completed",
      "Strategy narrative present, not checkbox alone",
      "Where an aid is used, it is named and its use described"
    ],
    "reason": "Template section does not satisfy derived template criteria: missing authored completionPrompt."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-support-delivery-client-safety",
    "requirement": "Support Delivery and Client Safety section contains support type checklist — in-home ADL, personal care, community access, transport and travel training, social/group activity, behavioural redirection, companionship and mentorship, therapeutic cleaning — plus description of support.",
    "targetLocation": "Support Delivery and Client Safety",
    "adequacyCriteria": [
      "Every selected support type has a corresponding description. Selected-with-no- description is a hard fail",
      "Descriptions state what the worker does, not what the support is called",
      "Selected supports reconcile against funded supports in the service agreement"
    ],
    "reason": "Template section does not satisfy derived template criteria: missing authored fixedContent (4/5); missing authored completionPrompt."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-behavioural-management",
    "requirement": "Behavioural Management section contains a table with behaviour, possible trigger, and redirection strategy.",
    "targetLocation": "Behavioural Management",
    "adequacyCriteria": [
      "Each row has all three columns",
      "Redirection strategies are drawn from the BSP, not invented",
      "Strategies are written for a support worker to execute"
    ],
    "reason": "Template section does not satisfy derived template criteria: missing authored fixedContent (3/4); missing authored completionPrompt."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-restrictive-practices",
    "requirement": "Restrictive Practices section contains a support-worker-friendly statement of what restrictive practices are in place.",
    "targetLocation": "Restrictive Practices",
    "adequacyCriteria": [
      "Each practice named in plain language a support worker understands",
      "What the worker does, and does not do",
      "Authorisation status stated as recorded in the BSP, never determined here"
    ],
    "reason": "Template section does not satisfy derived template criteria: missing authored fixedContent (5/5)."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-mealtime-management-strategy",
    "requirement": "Mealtime Management Strategy section contains the mealtime strategy a support worker executes.",
    "targetLocation": "Mealtime Management Strategy",
    "adequacyCriteria": [
      "Strategy drawn from the mealtime management risk assessment, cited",
      "Where no hands-on strategy is required, states so with reference to the assessment, and describes what does apply (mentorship, supervision, prompting)",
      "Written as worker actions"
    ],
    "reason": "Template section does not satisfy derived template criteria: missing authored fixedContent (2/3)."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-disaster-management-strategy",
    "requirement": "Disaster Management Strategy section contains participant-specific disaster and evacuation arrangements.",
    "targetLocation": "Disaster Management Strategy",
    "adequacyCriteria": [
      "States participant-specific arrangements, not a reproduction of the site plan",
      "Names the source risk assessment",
      "For community access, addresses both general and location-specific risk",
      "Written as worker actions",
      "[OPEN] Other settings: confirm"
    ],
    "reason": "Template section does not satisfy derived template criteria: missing authored fixedContent (1/2); missing declared template fields/structure: Community access: General risk arrangements, Location-specific risk arrangements, Transport contingency, What the worker carries, How the participant is returned to a safe location; missing authored completionPrompt."
  }
]

=== CURRENT DEFICIENT SECTIONS ===

[
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-support-plan-meeting",
    "heading": "Support Plan Meeting (Header)",
    "content": "Participant name: [PARTICIPANT_NAME]  \nDate of birth: [DATE_OF_BIRTH]  \nGender: [GENDER]  \nLanguage spoken: [LANGUAGE_SPOKEN]  \nNDIS number: [NDIS_NUMBER]  \nDiagnosis: [DIAGNOSIS]  \nPeople present: [PEOPLE_PRESENT]  \nSupport plan developed by: [SUPPORT_PLAN_DEVELOPED_BY]  \nPlan date: [PLAN_DATE]  \nDate for review: [DATE_FOR_REVIEW]  \n\nThis plan describes the supports to be delivered to the participant and how support workers are to deliver them. It must be read together with the participant's NDIS plan, service agreement, and any behaviour support plan, health support plan or risk assessment referenced in it.  \nWhere this plan was developed from written reports rather than a planning meeting, the source documents and their dates are recorded below."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-goals",
    "heading": "Goals",
    "content": "Table with columns Current situation | Goal | Actions | Person responsible | Timeframe | Outcomes  \n\nGoals are drawn from the participant's NDIS plan and from what the participant says matters to them. NDIS plan goals and personal goals are recorded together in the table below.  \nEvery goal must have a named person responsible and a target date. Support workers are responsible for working toward these goals in every shift, not only at review."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-about-me",
    "heading": "About Me",
    "content": "Strengths: [STRENGTHS]  \nLikes: [LIKES]  \nDislikes: [DISLIKES]  \nWhat matters to me: [WHAT_MATTERS]  \nHow I prefer to communicate: [COMMUNICATION_PREFERENCES]  \nPeople who matter to me: [PEOPLE_WHO_MATTER_TO_ME]  \nInformal supports: [INFORMAL_SUPPORTS]  \n\nThis section is about who the participant is, not what they cannot do. It is written to help a support worker understand the person before their first shift."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-history-background",
    "heading": "History and Background",
    "content": "Relevant history: [RELEVANT_HISTORY]  \nPrior service involvement: [PRIOR_SERVICE_INVOLVEMENT]  \nRisk-relevant context: [RISK_RELEVANT_CONTEXT]  \nSource documents and dates: [SOURCE_DOCUMENTS_AND_DATES]  \n\nThis section carries only the background a support worker needs to deliver safe, respectful support. It is not a clinical or case history. Every statement must be traceable to a named source document."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-undertaking-adl",
    "heading": "Undertaking ADL",
    "content": "Support is provided to build and maintain independence. Workers do for the participant only what the participant cannot do for themselves at that time. Where the participant's capacity changes, the change is recorded and the plan updated.  \nEach activity is recorded against one of three tiers: does independently, needs prompting or supervision, needs hands-on support."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-communication-strategy",
    "heading": "Communication and Communication Strategy",
    "content": "Verbal / non-verbal: [VERBAL_NON_VERBAL]  \nExpressive capacity: [EXPRESSIVE_CAPACITY]  \nReceptive capacity: [RECEPTIVE_CAPACITY]  \nCommunication aid or system used: [COMMUNICATION_AID_OR_SYSTEM_USED]  \nCommunication strategy: [COMMUNICATION_STRATEGY]  \n\nEvery worker must read and follow the communication strategy before their first shift with this participant. Communication difficulty is not a reason to make decisions on the participant's behalf. Where the participant uses a communication aid or system, it must be available and used at every shift."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-mobility-strategy",
    "heading": "Mobility and Mobility Strategy",
    "content": "Mobility aid required: [MOBILITY_AID_REQUIRED]  \nAid or equipment used: [AID_OR_EQUIPMENT_USED]  \nTransfer method: [TRANSFER_METHOD]  \nNumber of workers required: [NUMBER_OF_WORKERS_REQUIRED]  \nMobility overview: [MOBILITY_OVERVIEW]  \nMobility strategy: [MOBILITY_STRATEGY]  \n\nWhere a mobility aid or transfer equipment is used, it is named in this plan and must not be substituted."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-support-delivery-client-safety",
    "heading": "Support Delivery and Client Safety",
    "content": "Support types selected from — In-home ADL, Personal care, Community access, Transport and travel training, Social/group activity, Behavioural redirection, Companionship and mentorship, Therapeutic cleaning: [SUPPORT_TYPES]  \nDescription per selected type: [DESCRIPTION_PER_SELECTED_TYPE]  \nOn-call contact: [ON_CALL_CONTACT]  \nService manager contact: [SERVICE_MANAGER_CONTACT]  \n\nSupports are delivered only as funded in the participant's service agreement and NDIS plan. Workers must not deliver supports outside those recorded here without authorisation from the service manager."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-behavioural-management",
    "heading": "Behavioural Management",
    "content": "Table with columns Behaviour | Possible trigger | Redirection strategy  \n\nThe strategies below implement the participant's behaviour support plan. They do not replace it. Workers must read the behaviour support plan before their first shift."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-restrictive-practices",
    "heading": "Restrictive Practices",
    "content": "Practice type: [PRACTICE_TYPE]  \nWhat it is in plain language: [WHAT_IT_IS_IN_PLAIN_LANGUAGE]  \nWhat the worker does: [WHAT_THE_WORKER_DOES]  \nWhat the worker must not do: [WHAT_THE_WORKER_MUST_NOT_DO]  \nAuthorisation status and reference: [AUTHORISATION_STATUS_AND_REFERENCE]  \nRecording requirement: [RECORDING_REQUIREMENT]  \n\nA restrictive practice is any practice or intervention that has the effect of restricting the rights or freedom of movement of a person with disability."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-mealtime-management-strategy",
    "heading": "Mealtime Management Strategy",
    "content": "Source risk assessment and date: [SOURCE_RISK_ASSESSMENT_AND_DATE]  \nFood texture: [FOOD_TEXTURE]  \nFluid consistency: [FLUID_CONSISTENCY]  \nPositioning: [POSITIONING]  \nSupervision level: [SUPERVISION_LEVEL]  \nEquipment: [EQUIPMENT]  \nWorker actions: [WORKER_ACTIONS]  \n\nMealtime supports are delivered as described in the participant's mealtime management risk assessment. Workers must follow the strategy exactly and must not modify food or drink texture, consistency or presentation except as recorded here."
  },
  {
    "requirementId": "care-plan-disaster-management-strategy",
    "heading": "Disaster Management Strategy",
    "content": "SIL and supported accommodation: Evacuation assistance required: [EVACUATION_ASSISTANCE_REQUIRED]  \nAssembly point: [ASSEMBLY_POINT]  \nEquipment needed: [EQUIPMENT_NEEDED]  \nCommunication approach during evacuation: [COMMUNICATION_APPROACH_DURING_EVACUATION]  \nMedications or equipment to take: [MEDICATIONS_OR_EQUIPMENT_TO_TAKE]  \nWho to notify: [WHO_TO_NOTIFY]  \n\nIn any emergency, worker priority is the safety of the participant and themselves. Call 000 first, then notify the on-call service manager."
  }
]

Return deliverable.sections[] deltas only for the listed requirementIds. The server merges deltas into the existing section array and assembles markdown deterministically.
